_comment: Pinned corrections applied by build-zh-dicts.py after the WordNet pass: rows whose English line, Indonesian line or definition was corrected by hand (不能 fail → cannot, 卧室 bilik → kamar tidur). Keyed by headword only, because a headword moves between zh-core / zh-plus / zh-upper when the frequency list changes; each entry replaces the fields it names. pinyin-fixes.json pins readings.

造成.def: to cause or bring about (usually a bad result)

人物.def: a notable person; a character in a story

先生.def: polite title or address for a man; Mr.

方案.def: a plan or proposal for doing something

体系.def: a structured set of related parts; a system of ideas or institutions

充分.def: enough; ample; to the full extent

通用.def: used everywhere or for all purposes

传达.def: to pass on or communicate a message or instruction

玩笑.def: a joke; something said in jest

欢呼.def: to shout with joy or approval

品味.def: to savour; (noun) one's taste or refinement

奶油.def: the thick fatty part of milk, whipped for cakes and desserts

发热.def: to run a fever; to give off heat

和睦.def: living together peacefully and in harmony

椭圆形.def: an oval or elliptical shape; a flattened circle

口吻.def: the tone or manner in which someone speaks

回绝.def: to refuse or turn down a request or offer

校验.def: to check or validate for correctness

复述.def: to retell or restate in one's own words

腹痛.def: pain in the stomach or belly

情报.def: secret or official information, especially about an enemy or rival

做到.def: to manage to do or achieve something

意味.def: the meaning or implication of something

审问.def: to question someone formally and closely

机动车.def: a vehicle driven by an engine

吝啬.def: unwilling to spend money or give things

英寸.def: a unit of length equal to one twelfth of a foot (2.54 centimetres)

卫星.def: a natural or artificial object that orbits a planet; a satellite

有用.def: able to be used for a practical purpose; helpful

处置.def: deal with a matter or a person, often by taking firm action

失去.def: cease to have or fail to keep something

有效.def: producing the intended result; legally in force

亲戚.def: a person related to you by blood or marriage

共生.def: the living together of two different organisms, usually to the benefit of both

修理.def: restore something broken or damaged to good working order

缠住.def: wind around something and hold it fast

母牛.def: a mature female of domestic cattle

召回.def: to order the return of a product or person

保险.def: an arrangement in which you pay a company and it pays you if something bad happens

庇护.def: to protect someone from harm or danger

上学.def: to go to school as a pupil

吹嘘.def: to talk with excessive pride about oneself or one's achievements

申报.def: to report or declare to customs, tax or another authority

轰炸机.def: a military aircraft that drops bombs

包装.def: to wrap or box goods for sale; packaging
